Name: Twinfield Farm
Author: Novaphene
Description:
My brain is mushed so but yey!
Twinfield Farm is a custom farm map specifically for you and your friend/s. If you don't have one, atleast you have a big land!
[size=3](❁´◡`❁)

[b]If you or your co-farmer encounter bugs or issues with this mod, please send me your [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi log[/url] and your friend's as well!

[center]Socials:  [url=https://www.tumblr.com/nova-phene]Tumblr[/url] |  [url=https://bsky.app/profile/novaphene.bsky.social]Bsky (bluesky)[/url][/center][/b][/size]Thanks so much to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Abagaianye]Abagaianye[/url]﻿ and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/irocendar]irocendar[/url] for helping me with my map problems. Please give them support and check out their mods (especially the [b]Trick or Treat[/b] from Aba, and [b]Map Event Markers[/b] from irocendar if you're forgetful like me) as well!!
